case_title: PAUL A. BILLINGSLEY VS. CLIFF PARKER

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $6,300.00 FILED BY BILLINGSLEY, PAUL A. AS TO DEFENDANT PARKER, CLIFF ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-03-2021 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF BILLINGSLEY, PAUL A. AS TO DEFENDANT PARKER, CLIFF
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED JUN-17-2021, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT PARKER, CLIFF

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF PAUL A. BILLINGSLEY IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT CLIFF PARKER AKA CLIFFORD PARKER IS PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $1027.50 TO THE PLAINTIFF. THE DEFENDANT'S INITIAL PAYMENT OF $700 (UNCASHED CHECK) TO THE PLAINTIFF WAS GIVEN BACK TO THE DEFENDANT IN COURT. THE DEFENDANT ELECTRONICALLY PAID THE ENTIRE AMOUNT OF $1027.50 AND THEREFORE THE CASE IS DEEMED SETTLED AND DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
ORDER CASE CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.
